name: Reviewer
summary: Fresh-context adversarial review of the branch diff against the ticket's contract before the launch card: a confidence per finding, a diff walkthrough for you, and a receipt bound to HEAD. Also drafts reviews of teammates' PRs on request.

blockAtConfidence.label: Findings at or above this confidence (1-10) must be fixed or argued

useTeamChecks.label: Use the team pack's review checks (for example, a code-review skill's families)
